programme.title: Pet Sematary

programme.title: Hush

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut

programme.title: Butter (aka Never 2 Big)

programme.title: Dead Presidents

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a fashion designer who must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

programme.title: Legionnaire

programme.title: Replicant

programme.title: Good Burger

programme.title: Licorice Pizza

programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.title: Grease

programme.title: Pretty In Pink

programme.title: Primal Fear

programme.title: Dressed to Kill

programme.title: Borderline (2023)

programme.title: Postcards from the Edge

programme.title: Rules of Engagement

programme.title: Gloria Bell
programme.desc: Gloria (Julianne Moore) spends her nights joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles and finds herself thrust into an unexpected and complicated new romance.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

programme.title: Hondo

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers (2011)
programme.desc: A gifted ensemble cast sparks this bold retelling of Alexander Dumas’ classic tale of friendship and heroism. With Christoph Waltz as wily Cardinal Richelieu.

programme.title: The Host (2013)
programme.desc: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: Gladiator

programme.title: Moesha

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Still reeling from the news that Frank is Dorian’s biological father, the Mitchells prepare for Dorian’s 17th birthday bash, a party that grows more and more elaborate and expensive as Dorian takes full advantage of Frank’s guilt.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: Steve (Steve Harvey) has trouble when Bullethead and Romeo (William Lee Scott, Merlin Santana) takes the keys to the driver's education car.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: Steve and Regina (Steve Harvey, Wendy Raquel Robinson) take a romantic cruise, but everything seems to go wrong; Lydia (guest star Lori Beth Denberg) housesits.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland

programme.title: Bound

programme.title: Bad Boys

programme.title: Son of Rambow

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails and Trautman is captured by Russian troops. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the own is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: The heat is on in this fast-paced action-comedy starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a street smart Detroit cop tracking down his best friend's killer in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: The heat's back on! And Eddie Murphy is cool as ever in this sizzling, smash-hit sequel to Beverly Hills Cop.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: After his wife is brutally murdered, ex-mobster Ben Archer wages war against the Chinese triads. Starring action legend Jean-Claude Van Damme.

programme.title: Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Deep within a forest on the US-Canadian border, two sworn enemies must work together to escape a ruthless drug cartel hell-bent on retrieving a drug shipment which went missing there.

programme.title: Black Water (2017)
programme.desc: A deep-cover operative (Van Damme) imprisoned on a CIA submarine teams with a fellow prisoner (Lundgren) for an electrifying fight to escape in this action-powered thriller.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Queenpins
programme.desc: A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.

programme.title: Moms' Night Out
programme.desc: All Allyson and her friends want is a long-needed moms' night out. But to enjoy it, they need their husbands to watch the kids for a few hours-what could go wrong?

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: In Dreams
programme.desc: Claire Cooper's (Annette Bening) peaceful family life takes a chilling turn when a mysterious serial killer (Robert Downey Jr.) invades her seemingly idylic New England town and haunts her dreams with dark clues to his next deadly moves.

programme.title: Under the Silver Lake
programme.desc: When his beautiful, mysterious neighbor disappears without a trace, Sam (Andrew Garfield) tries to find the parties responsible, unraveling a string of strange crimes, unsolved murders, & bizarre coincidences in his East L.A. neighborhood.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: A sprawling epic about family, faith, power and oil. The story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: Gunfight At The O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Frontier lawman Wyatt Earp joins his three brothers in their feud against the villainous Clanton gang, a local clan of cattle thieves in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: When high school senior Tripp discovers a gas-guzzling creature named Creech, the unlikely duo team up for a fun-filled, hilarious and heartfelt adventure in a real-life super-powered Monster Truck to reunite Creech with his family.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon that aspires to be a swashbuckling hero finds himself in a Western town plagued by bandits and is forced to literally play the role in order to protect it.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers (2011)
programme.desc: A gifted ensemble cast sparks this bold retelling of Alexander Dumas’ classic tale of friendship and heroism. With Christoph Waltz as wily Cardinal Richelieu.

programme.title: Miles Ahead
programme.desc: In the midst of a prolific career, Miles Davis virtually disappears from public view in the late 1970s, his musical voice stifled by drugs. Plagued by years of regret and loss, Davis flirts with annihilation until he once again finds salvation in his art.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments
programme.desc: Clary's life is turned upside down when her mother is kidnapped and it's revealed that they are shadowhunters who are tasked with protecting the world from vampires, werewolves and demons. Clary must discover her talents and save her mother.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: During the last week of school, Chris is informed that if he gets one more tardy he will have to repeat the 10th grade.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: After Chris tests poorly on a standard exam, his teacher, Ms. Morello, refers him to the school's guidance counselor, Mr. Abbott.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Caruso relinquishes his role as school bully after getting bullied himself. However, without Caruso to establish the school's power hierarchy and with everyone vying to fill his shoes, Chris and Greg realize they'd better come up with a fast solution.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Things take a literal turn for the worse when a license-less Chris volunteers to move his dad's car, but finds himself driving the car all the way to school as a result of trying to impress Tasha. Rochelle spends an interesting day at traffic court.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Melanie wants to put a stop to Dane passionately kissing Victoria in a play, bet-losing Elka is forced to wear a Bengal costume, and Joy tests Bob's honesty.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Owen's wedding includes Melanie getting an inappropriate cake, a surprise visit by Simon, the bride's father knowing Victoria's secret and a patient reverend.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Elka and her friends pose nude for a calendar, Joy and Bob have difficulty taking their engagement portrait, and Victoria tries to replace her driver's license photo.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: On the women's restaurant's opening night, Melanie deals with an unstable chef, Victoria leads on a sommelier, Joy hopes to impress a baby mama, and Elka flirts with the pope.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Investing in her theater production, Victoria's son Tony asks to be in it, as Elka competes with Victoria's mother for a role, and Melanie and Joy have posterior insecurity.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: Recently freed from prison, Frank White (Christopher Walken) begins to exterminate the drug lords who rose to power in his absence. When a group of enraged cops declares war on him, Frank's answer is to put a contract out on the cops.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: A lonely divorcée visits a bewitching London department store to find a dress to transform her life. She finds a perfect, artery-red gown that unleashes a malevolent, unstoppable curse in this frightening, seductive, and darkly funny tale.

programme.title: Trust (2025)
programme.desc: A Hollywood star seeks refuge in an Airbnb after a scandal, only to find themselves at the mercy of seasoned criminals hunting a loot.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: Dismissed some time ago from the FBI, Mark Kaminsky is contacted by his old boss, Shannon, whose son has been murdered. Shannon needs Kaminsky's help and offers to re-instate him if he is successful.

programme.title: The Wraith
programme.desc: Jake is killed by neighborhood thugs, and returns as a mystical figure (The Wraith) to gain revenge. Starring Charlie Sheen and Randy Quaid.

programme.title: Without A Paddle
programme.desc: Seth Green, Matthew Lillard and Dax Shepard star in this offbeat comedy as childhood friends whose lives have drifted apart but must reunite following the sudden death of a fourth friend.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker, until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves behind Orange County to study creative writing Stanford University.

programme.title: Son of Rambow
programme.desc: A hilariously fresh take on friendship, family, film heroes and the death-defying adventures of growing up in the video age.

programme.title: Prison On Fire II
programme.desc: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son, who he has been put in an orphanage. And that puts him in great danger.

programme.title: City On Fire

programme.title: The Killer [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A disillusioned assassin accepts one last hit in hopes of using his earnings to restore vision to a singer he accidentally blinded.

programme.title: Green Room

programme.title: Rabbit Trap

programme.title: Hereditary

programme.title: The Godfather

programme.title: The Raid 2 (Subtitled)

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Incluso los lugares más inofensivos pueden guardar las cicatrices de un pasado retorcido. El mal puede perdurar a través del tiempo, puede permanecer latente hasta que alguna persona ingenua, o algún inocente, se crucen en su camino sin darse cuenta.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Mientras una entidad alienígena hace estragos con la computadora de la estación, la irrefrenable Lwaxana Troi pone la mira en un romance con Odo.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Odo queda en el medio cuando una influencia alienígena enfrenta a Kira contra Sisko en una lucha fatal por el poder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Kira se ve obligada a analizar sus prejuicios posocupación sobre los cardasianos cuando en su batalla de ingenio con un prisionero que afirma ser un famoso líder de campo de exterminio descubre que en realidad es su archivador arrepentido.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Cuando un líder espiritual bajorano se opone a las enseñanzas seculares de Keiko, ella amenaza con destruir la alianza entre Bajor y la Federación.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Kira arriesga su vida y se arriesga a comenzar una guerra con los cardasianos para rescatar a un mítico héroe bajorano de una colonia penal lejana.

programme.title: Underworld

programme.title: Los hambrientos

programme.title: El Metiche

programme.title: La red de corrupción

programme.title: La belleza de la vida

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Un agente es culpado injustamente por planear el asesinato del presidente.

programme.title: Tierra de Nadie

programme.title: Egg

programme.title: Ariana Grande: Con gran estilo

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Horatio y su equipo se apresuran para encontrar nuevas pruebas para un juicio en curso por asesinato para evitar la condena de un hombre posiblemente inocente.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: El caso de Horatio de una mujer asesinada se ve comprometido cuando se involucran los agentes federales, que tienen su propio plan a seguir.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Un ex-convicto que Horatio envió a la cárcel le pide que lo ayude a encontrar a su hijo desaparecido. Él encuentra marihuana mientras busca en la habitación del chico.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: El Enemigo Invisible

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: El Objetivo Aparece

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso ataca a Kagome. Inuyasha lo destruye con su Cicatriz de Viento. Naraku, que estaba viendo el evento, le dice a Kagura que le diga a Inuyasha a dónde fue Muso. Después de que Inuyasha y los otros se van, Muso se regenera.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso se regenera incluso cuando fue golpeado con la Cicatriz del Viento. Miroku le dice a Inuyasha que Muso tiene un corazón en el área donde tiene una marca de araña. Pero Kagura interfiere, y las avispas del infierno quitan el fragmento de Muso.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Inuyasha visita Totosai en busca de una técnica que pueda romper la barrera de Naraku. Allí se encuentra con Bunza, un niño demonio salvaje. Los dos hacen lo que Totosai les ordena. Bunza actúa como si fuera el discípulo más viejo.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Myoga viene a entregar un mensaje de Totosai. Él dice que la Tetsusaiga se volverá más fuerte si corta un Murciélago Hyakki, un demonio que puede crear una barrera poderosa. Inuyasha buscan el nido de los murciélagos Hyakki, que está cerca del mar.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: El demonio Otakemaru intenta destruir el pueblo junto con la madre de Shiori. Inuyasha está bloqueado por la barrera de Shiori y no puede derrotar a Otakemaru. Shizu le pide a Otakemaru que respete la voluntad de su difunto esposo y salve la aldea.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Cuando Jotaro y el equipo llegan a Lúxor, Joseph recibe una descarga al tocar una extraña piedra que lleva incrustada una toma de corriente eléctrica.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Joseph y Avdol se quedan atrapados juntos por culpa de un Stand enemigo. Cuando finalmente logran separarse, los pies se les quedan enganchados en las vías del tren.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Polnareff debe pelear con su pequeño Stand contra Alessi, un usuario de Stand mucho más joven. Cuando las cosas se ponen feas, Polnareff recurre a lo inimaginable.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Jotaro y su equipo llegan finalmente a El Cairo. Allí conocen a un hombre que afirma saber dónde está la mansión de Dio, pero la información no les va a salir gratis.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Jotaro hace gala de sus habilidades como Stand para poner sobre aviso a quien tenga intención de hacer trampas en la partida de póquer en la que va a participar.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En búsqueda de un Maestro Tierra, los niños van a un torneo que destaca varios maestros poderosos. Allí, conocen a Toph, una ciega pero potente Maestra Tierra. Después de ver su estilo, Aang quiere que Toph le enseñe.

programme.desc: Una ferengi que ha desafiado la ley al disfrazarse de hombre arriesga todo cuando se enamora de Quark.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡¿Es posible escapar?! ¡La Prueba de Dios se pone en marcha!
programme.desc: Como ahora son considerados criminales, algunos de los Sombrero de Paja están dispuestos a abandonar la isla del cielo para volver a "su mundo". Para ello contarán con la ayuda de Conis, quien les explicará una forma de salir de allí.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
